agnostic_oa_blowup_categorical_decomposi.boundary_or_failure: The formula assumes a blowup of a smooth variety along a smooth center of codimension r. agnostic_oa_blowup_categorical_decomposi.interpretation: Inference: blowing up preserves the entire derived category of the original variety and adds a controlled number of copies of the center's category. Codimension determines exactly how many new categorical layers appear.
agnostic_oa_blowup_categorical_decomposi.nonparaphrase_operation: Form the exceptional divisor as the projective normal bundle of the center. Embed the original category by derived pullback along the blowup. For each relative line-bundle twist from minus r plus one through minus one, pull an object from the center to the exceptional divisor, tensor by that twist, and push it into the blowup. Verify these functors are fully faithful, order their images by increasing twist, and use the stated theorem to generate the blowup category with those center blocks followed by the original block.
agnostic_oa_blowup_categorical_decomposi.quality_reason: The candidate faithfully states preservation of the original category by blowup pullback, the repeated center images through the exceptional divisor, the consecutive negative twists, their count and order, and the essential smoothness and codimension assumptions.
